doc: Which installed strokes pack serves a character for a reader of a language (GET /hanzi/U<HEX>.json?lang=<code>). Packs are listed in order of registration (ord). A pack that lists the language comes first; among those the pack with the fewest languages (made for that language) wins; then the earlier pack. A character only one pack has is served whatever the language; an absent or unlisted language falls back to the order of registration. data is a label for the pack's data for the character. Go: server/internal/strokes/contract_test.go.

cases.why: no language: the first pack registered
